RDR2 Vulkan Frame Generation adapts the XeSS host-unlock reference for
experimental 3x/4x operation while retaining the native 2x model.
This attribution does not imply upstream endorsement or verified gameplay.
Local adaptations: C++17 containers; rollback verification distinguishes
an untouched unsupported layout from an unverified write transaction.

SDK output pacing adaptation:
The pinned MIT reference's sdk_pacing_dlssg.h BatchIntervalEstimator and
NativeDeadline math and intermediate-output pacing calls are adapted for
XeSS native output deadlines in
src/xess_output_pacing.cpp. The estimator uses recent SDK batch-start
intervals and the total output count for 2x/3x/4x cadence. The original
SDK deadline function runs first; replacement requires a recognized SDK
layout/call site and verified runtime context ownership, D3D12 identity,
and non-Intel software mode. The SDK's existing wait/present path remains
in use. Unsupported layouts/ownership retain the original SDK deadline.
Local lifecycle adaptations reset cadence on transitions, unregister the
owner before context destruction, and keep callback dependencies loaded.
This is a compatibility adaptation; gameplay cadence is not yet confirmed.
